concept: Noticing patterns that repeat (like seasons, daily routines, or shapes in nature)
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character notices a repeating pattern in nature or daily life and uses it to predict what happens next
exercise.reflection_prompt: How did noticing the pattern help the character?
exercise.practice: Student names one pattern they've noticed in their own life or surroundings

assessment.success_marker: student names a genuine, specific repeating pattern
